title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics helpers and SLO toolkit integrations
description:
Context: Oncall responders frequently need quick access to correlated SLO context, recent runbook links, and basic diagnostics (top N logs, recent deploys, active alerts) during an incident. This PR adds a set of lightweight helper commands and SLO toolkit hooks to the incident-bot to surface that data automatically in oncall messages and to attach compact runbook links to auto-diagnostics.

What this PR changes: - New command `/ibot diagnostics <alert-id>` which returns a compact diagnostics summary including correlated SLOs, recent deploy metadata, top 5 error logs (sampled), and recommended runbook links. - SLO toolkit integration: incident-bot calls the slo-toolkit diagnostics endpoint to fetch pre-computed SLO correlations when a runbook is attached or when diagnostics are requested. - Oncall helper: when an alert page is created, incident-bot will append a short helper block with one-click runbook links, SLO quick-stats, and a link to trigger a full auto-diagnostics run. - Metrics and tracing: 3 new metrics (ibot.diagnostics.requests, ibot.diagnostics.latency_ms, ibot.diagnostics.failures) and tracing spans around the slo-toolkit call. - Rate limiting and permissions: diagnostics command is restricted to oncall group; added unit tests for permission checks.

Motivation: Faster mean-time-to-detection and resolution by surfacing the most relevant operational context without leaving the paging flow. This ties into ongoing work ENG-2148 (oncall playbooks) and ENG-2072 (slo-toolkit correlations).

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for command parsing and permission checks - [x] Integration test for slo-toolkit fallback logic - [x] Metrics emitted and tested - [x] Docs updated (lightweight usage note in incident-bot README) - [x] Security review for oncall-only endpoint

Notes: The description intentionally keeps the payload small (samples instead of full logs) to avoid noisy pages. The slo-toolkit integration uses a cached endpoint and falls back to a lite correlation pass if the service is unavailable.

review_comments: Marco Liu: Please make sure the diagnostics payload can't leak sensitive log lines — recommend redacting user identifiers before sampling.
Anika Bose: Thanks Marco — added a redaction step and unit test to verify PII patterns are scrubbed from sampled logs.
Ravi Patel: Integration looks good; can we add a short circuit if slo-toolkit is degraded to avoid adding latency to pages?
Anika Bose: Added cached endpoint usage and a 200ms soft timeout. If slo-toolkit fails, bot returns a compact local correlation pass and emits a diagnostic failure metric.
release_notes: Added /ibot diagnostics command to provide compact oncall diagnostics with SLO correlations and quick runbook links. Restricted to oncall group. Metrics and tracing included.
